text: Kernel services that read or write kernel-owned tables during an active module request must wrap those queries in kernel DB escalation (`KernelPDO::kernelEscalationEnter()` / `kernelEscalationLeave()`). Do not query kernel-owned tables via `app()->db()` without escalation while `_activeModuleContext` is set, or the ModuleDB ownership gate will deny the access.
